authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism in lighting, shadows, and texture for the rabbits and trucks, with no significant graphics-level distortions (perceptual_quality_auditor returned null). However, it contains severe semantic and structural artifacts. The elephants are rendered as smooth, untextured purple plastic toys rather than biological entities, failing all anatomical taxonomy checkpoints (no skin wrinkles, no twin-domed skulls, simplified trunks). Furthermore, the stacking of the elephants defies physics, with the top row balancing precariously on the heads of the bottom row without support. While the rendering quality is high, the content represents a hallucinated scene with toy-like objects instead of real animals, significantly reducing authenticity despite the clean pixel-level output.
